# `idempotency_key`

Area: **worker** ([all tables](README.md))

Stored success response of a request carrying an Idempotency-Key, per operator, method and route.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operator` | `text` | no |  | Signed-in user or MCP principal that sent the key. |
| `method` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `route` | `text` | no |  | Request path the key was used on. |
| `key` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `request_hash` | `text` | no |  | SHA-256 of the normalized query and body; the same key with another request is a 409. |
| `status_code` | `integer` | no |  |  |
| `response` | `jsonb` | yes |  | Stored response body, replayed unchanged. |
| `location` | `text` | yes |  | Stored Location header, if the response had one. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `tombstoned_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Set once when the created resource was deleted: the key then answers 409 and is never reused. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `idempotency_key_check` | check | `CHECK (((tombstoned_at IS NULL) OR (tombstoned_at >= created_at)))` |
| `idempotency_key_key_check` | check | `CHECK ((key ~ '^[\x21-\x7e]{1,255}$'::text))` |
| `idempotency_key_method_check` | check | `CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['POST'::text, 'PATCH'::text, 'DELETE'::text])))` |
| `idempotency_key_operator_check` | check | `CHECK ((operator <> ''::text))` |
| `idempotency_key_request_hash_check` | check | `CHECK ((request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))` |
| `idempotency_key_route_check` | check | `CHECK ((route ~~ '/%'::text))` |
| `idempotency_key_status_code_check` | check | `CHECK (((status_code >= 200) AND (status_code <= 299)))` |
| `idempotency_key_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (operator, method, route, key)` |
